summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Investigation summary (read-only)  I traced the full chain end to end and, contrary to the ticket's assumption, **didn't find an obvious bug**:  - **Schema**: `watchlists.user_id` is a persistent column tied to the `users.id` (nanoid), not a session id. Correct. - **Auth**: `signUp`/`login` in `db/auth.ts` key users by email (unique check on signup), so the same person always gets the same `user.id` across logins. Sessions store `user_id` correctly, 30-day expiry. - **Server**: `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` has its own auth middleware (mirrors the pattern in `server.ts` for portfolio/pric
